searchText: <Highlander1969> For those interested, the L2 Standards WG will be discussing tomorrow (6/26 at 7 am PT / 10 am ET / 16:0]0GMT /17:00 CET / 6:30 pm IST ) the L2 Transaction Fee API spec PR (https://github.com/ethereum-oasis-op/L2/pull/53). In particular L2 tx statuses and their drfinitions. Meeting zoom link is here: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81599021689?pwd=VmxPVUNCVmE5RkkweGY1YmN1OWMrZz09 (re @eliastzr: I think wallets and block explorers should be able to convey similar levels of heuristics about a tx status (though block explorers display a lot more info) Every rollup has on their block explorer some notion of soft finality vs. strong finality Maybe we could unite into an RIP and name those 3 to 4 states a tx goes through so wallets accurately help users navigate this security space (could simply end up being the color of the ✅) Same for etherjs and similar tools that rely on logic such as block mining to confirm a tx (this also paves the way for supporting preconfs on L1))

<Highlander1969> For those interested, the L2 Standards WG will be discussing tomorrow (6/26 at 7 am PT / 10 am ET / 16:0]0GMT /17:00 CET / 6:30 pm IST ) the L2 Transaction Fee API spec PR (https://github.com/ethereum-oasis-op/L2/pull/53). In particular L2 tx statuses and their drfinitions. 

Meeting zoom link is here:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81599021689?pwd=VmxPVUNCVmE5RkkweGY1YmN1OWMrZz09 (re @eliastzr: I think wallets and block explorers should be able to convey similar levels of heuristics about a tx status (though block explorers display a lot more info)

Every rollup has on their block explorer some notion of soft finality vs. strong finality 

Maybe we could unite into an RIP and name those 3 to 4 states a tx goes through so wallets accurately help users navigate this security space (could simply end up being the color of the ✅)
Same for etherjs and similar tools that rely on logic such as block mining to confirm a tx 
(this also paves the way for supporting preconfs on L1))
